paragraphs: Beazer Homes is a nationally recognized homebuilder committed to building homes and communities designed with the intention of inspiring sustainable and healthier living. With personalized options and expert guidance, we empower homebuyers with competitive mortgage choices and energy saving features that make homeownership more attainable. Operating across 13 states in the West, East, and Southeast geographic regions of the United States, Beazer Homes offers a diverse portfolio of products tailored to meet the evolving needs of homebuyers that value a well-constructed and energy efficient home.

Beazer Homes USA, Inc. was incorporated in Delaware in 1993. Our principal executive offices are located at 2002 Summit Blvd NE, 15th Floor, Atlanta, GA 30319, and our main telephone number is (770) 829-3700. We also provide information about our company, including active communities, online at www.beazer.com. Information on our website is not a part of this Form 10-K and shall not be deemed incorporated by reference.

We continue to execute against our long-term balanced growth strategy, which is focused on growing profitability, improving balance sheet efficiency, and generating returns above our cost of capital, while minimizing operational risk and financial leverage. In response to changing market conditions, we intend to balance decreasing leverage and returning capital to investors through stock repurchases, as we make investments to grow the business long-term.

Earlier this year, we updated our Multi-Year Goals, originally introduced in fiscal 2023, which reflected objectives aligned with our balanced growth strategy. For fiscal 2026, we expect continued progress on these goals, which include:
•reaching more than 200 active communities by the end of fiscal 2027,
•reducing our net debt to net capitalization ratio to the low 30% range by the end of fiscal 2027, and
•achieving a double-digit compound annual growth rate in book value per share from the end of fiscal 2024 through fiscal 2027.

Beazer crafts homes intended to inspire sustainable and healthier living. We focus on four points of strategic differentiation that we believe deliver meaningful financial and lifestyle benefits to our buyers. Our points of differentiation are as follows:

Advanced Home Performance – Every Beazer home is built to deliver measurable, industry-leading advantages in efficiency, comfort, and durability. Our construction standards support healthier, quieter and more comfortable living environments while reducing ongoing operating costs, particularly in regard to energy efficiency and utility bills. Key performance elements include:

•Energy Savings: This is one of several ways we are helping buyers address increasingly prevalent affordability concerns. We have become a leading energy-efficient homebuilder, delivering proven efficiency and lowering monthly utility costs to our customers. To quantify and convey the benefits of our construction, we provide buyers with an individual energy rating (HERS® index score) for their home, completed by a qualified third-party rating company. According to the Residential Energy Services Network, used homes typically have a HERS index score (a lower score on scale is better) of 130, while homes built to the same standard as the HERS Reference Home (equivalent to the 2006 International Energy Conservation Code) have a HERS index score of 100. By comparison, new Beazer homes had an average HERS index score of 32 for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, demonstrating the significant outperformance resulting from our construction.

As part of our commitment to energy efficiency, substantially all of Beazer's newly constructed homes meet the Department of Energy's Zero Energy Ready standard, meaning an appropriately sized renewable energy source (such as solar) can supply all of the home's energy needs, minimizing usage and expenses. By ensuring all homes have the proper infrastructure for solar installation (solar-ready), we are enabling customers to pursue solar investments on their own timeframe, while still providing the significant benefits of highly efficient construction. Further, we have begun introducing solar-included communities, in which every home will include a fully installed solar energy system.

•Cleaner Air: Through our commitment to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's (the EPA) Indoor AirPlus program, we are creating a healthier breathing environment for our homeowners with HVAC systems specifically designed to deliver improved indoor air quality.

•Quieter Home: Our enhanced building practices include added insulation that not only minimizes temperature fluctuations and improve energy efficiency, but also reduces noise, creating a more peaceful and comfortable living environment.
Curated Choices – Beazer has long been known for offering choices, and we have expanded and reframed what choice means to better meet the evolving needs of our homebuyers.

headings: Inflation may adversely affect us by increasing costs beyond what we can recover through price increases.

If we are unsuccessful in competing against other homebuilders, our market share could decline or our growth could be impeded and, as a result, our financial condition and results of operations could suffer.
An increase in cancellation rates will negatively impact our business and could lead to imprecise estimates related to homes to be delivered in the future (backlog).
Our long-term success depends on our ability to acquire finished lots and undeveloped land suitable for residential homebuilding at reasonable prices, in accordance with our land investment criteria.
Reduced numbers of home sales extend the time it takes us to recover land purchase and property development costs, negatively impacting profitability and our results of operations.
Natural disasters and other related events could result in delays in land development or home construction, increase our costs or decrease demand in the impacted areas.

Supply shortages and other risks related to the demand for skilled labor and building materials could increase costs, delay deliveries and could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
We are subject to extensive government regulation, which could cause us to incur significant liabilities or restrict our business activities.
Limitations on, or the elimination of, tax benefits in connection with the federal "Energy Star" or "Zero Energy" programs could be material to our business.
Our activities and disclosures related to sustainability expose us to risks.
We may be subject to significant potential liabilities as a result of construction defect, product liability and warranty claims made against us.
At any given time, we may be the subject of civil litigation that could require us to pay substantial damages or could otherwise have a material adverse effect on us.
We are dependent on the services of certain key employees and the loss of their services could hurt our business.
Information technology failures, cybersecurity breaches or data security breaches could harm our business.
Global economic and political instability and conflicts could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
Terrorist attacks or acts of war against the United States or increased domestic or international instability could have an adverse effect on our operations.

Our access to capital and our ability to obtain additional financing could be affected by any downgrade of our credit ratings, as well as limitations in the capital markets or adverse credit market conditions.
Our ability to use our net operating losses and tax credits has been, and may in the future be, impacted by an "ownership change" pursuant to Section 382 and Section 383 of the Internal Revenue Code.
We could experience a reduction in home sales and revenues due to our inability to acquire and develop land for our communities if we are unable to obtain reasonably priced financing.
Inefficient or ineffective allocation of capital could adversely affect our operating results and/or stockholder value.
Risk Relating to an Investment in our Common Stock
We experience fluctuations and variability in our operating results on a quarterly basis and, as a result, our historical performance may not be a meaningful indicator of future results.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the following risk factors, as well as other information in this Form 10-K, before deciding whether to invest in shares of our common stock. The occurrence of any of the events described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. In such an event, the trading price of our common stock may decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

A number of conditions that affect demand for the homes we sell are outside of our control. Many of these conditions, such as interest rates, inflation, employment levels, wage levels and governmental actions also impact consumer confidence, upon which our business is highly dependent.

Negative changes in national and regional economic conditions, as well as local economic conditions where we conduct our operations, may result in more caution on the part of homebuyers and, consequently, fewer home purchases. Demand softened during fiscal 2025 as homebuyers continued to face an elevated interest rate environment despite interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve multiple times during fiscal 2025. This continued economic uncertainty is out of our control, affects buyer sentiment and behavior and the demand for the homes we sell, and negatively impacts consumer confidence, upon which our business is highly dependent.

A worsening of these conditions and/or further downturns in the homebuilding industry could also, among other things, result in an oversupply of both new and resale home inventory across housing markets in the U.S., an increase in foreclosures, reduced levels of consumer demand for new homes, increased cancellation rates, aggressive price competition among homebuilders, and increased incentives for home sales, any of which could result in a decrease in our revenues, earnings, or margins and adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

In addition, any certain government actions such as continuance of the U.S. federal government shutdown or U.S. initiated tariffs on certain foreign goods, particularly raw materials, commodities, and products manufactured outside the United States that are used in our homebuilding processes, may disrupt our home closings process or cause our homebuilding costs to rise, which would have a negative impact on our business and results of operations.

Because most of our customers require mortgage financing, elevated mortgage interest rates for prolonged periods and further increases in interest rates would likely negatively affect the affordability of the homes we sell. In addition, reductions in mortgage availability or increases in the effective costs of owning a home could prevent our customers from buying our homes and adversely affect our business and financial results.

paragraphs: Fiscal 2025 presented a challenging operating environment, driven by persistent affordability concerns, elevated mortgage rates, weak consumer sentiment, and continued uncertainties in the macroeconomic environment. In response, we offered discounts and incentives to stimulate sales and turn inventory. We also maintained a disciplined approach to our operations and capital allocation. This included slowing land spend to match current market conditions, renegotiating more favorable land acquisition terms, and pursuing capital-efficient growth opportunities through expanded usage of lot option agreements. During fiscal 2025, we allocated more capital to share repurchases, as our shares traded at a discount to book value, which we believe represented a compelling investment opportunity. Despite the soft selling environment, we continue to see longer-term housing market conditions as favorable with production shortfalls over the past decade contributing to a fundamental long-term undersupply of housing.
During fiscal 2025, we made steady progress toward our Multi-Year Goals and remain on track to achieve each of these objectives.
•Growth: reaching more than 200 active communities by the end of fiscal 2027,
•Deleveraging: reducing our net debt to net capitalization ratio to the low 30% range by the end of fiscal 2027, and
•Book value per share: achieving a double-digit compound annual growth rate in book value per share from the end of fiscal 2024 through fiscal 2027.

As of September 30, 2025, our ending active community count was 169, up 4.3% from 162 in the prior year. This marks the third consecutive year of growth in community count as we work towards our goal of reaching more than 200 active communities by the end of fiscal 2027.

Our total debt to total capitalization ratio and net debt to net capitalization ratio were 45.2% and 39.5%, respectively, as of September 30, 2025, down 20 basis points and 50 basis points, respectively, compared to the prior year, despite the difficult environment. This reduction reflects our capital allocation and strategic asset alignment decisions to moderate land spend and increase land sales. With a strong balance sheet and ample liquidity, we believe we are well-equipped to navigate the evolving market dynamics and reduce our net debt to net capitalization ratio to the low 30% range by the end of fiscal 2027.

Our book value per share as of September 30, 2025 was $42.57, up from $40.05 in the prior year, an increase of 6.3%. This growth reflects our continued profitability and active share repurchase program, which has contributed meaningfully to long-term value creation. During fiscal 2025, we repurchased 1.5 million shares of our common stock, approximately 5% of our outstanding shares, for $33.1 million at an average price per share of $22.20.

As we look to fiscal 2026, we continue to advance towards the achievement of our Multi-Year Goals, while maintaining a strong liquidity position. We are accelerating our brand-building and marketing efforts to communicate our differentiated value proposition and drive customer engagement. A key component of this proposition is the energy efficiency of our homes, which enables homeowners to generate meaningful utility savings and reduce their total cost of ownership. We believe these operational and strategic initiatives will enhance our differentiated market position and support significant value creation for our stockholders.
The following is a summary of our performance against certain key operating and financial metrics during fiscal 2025, as compared to fiscal 2024.

•During the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, our average active community count of 164 was up 14.2% from 144 in the prior year. As of September 30, 2025, our ending active community count was 169, up 4.3% from 162 in the prior year. We invested $684.0 million in land acquisition and land development during the year ended September 30, 2025, down 11.9% compared to $776.5 million in land spend during the year ended September 30, 2024. In response to the evolving market conditions, we reallocated a portion of our land investment toward reaching our Multi-Year Goals of deleveraging and growing book value per share. This shift underscores our confidence in our strong land position and the visibility we have into our community count growth.

paragraphs: Beazer Homes 是一家 nationally recognized homebuilder，致力於建造設計用以啟發永續與健康生活的住宅與社區。透過個性化選擇與專業指導，我們賦予購屋者具競爭力的房貸選擇與節能特點，使購屋更加可行。本公司於美國西部、東部與東南地區的 13 個州運作，提供多樣化的產品組合，以符合購屋者對高品質與節能住宅的進步需求。

Beazer Homes USA, Inc. 於 1993 年在特拉華州成立。本公司主要營業據點位於 2002 Summit Blvd NE, 15th Floor, Atlanta, GA 30319，主要電話為 (770) 829-3700。本公司亦於網站 www.beazer.com 提供有關本公司之資訊，包括現有社區資訊。本公司網站之資訊並非本 Form 10-K 之一部分，亦不得視為經引用之資訊。
我們持續執行長期平衡成長策略，該策略聚焦於提升獲利能力、改善資產負債表效率、產生超過我們資本成本的回報，同時降低營運風險與財務槓桿。面對市場條件的變化，我們意圖透過股票回購來平衡降低槓桿與回饋投資者，同時進行長遠業務成長投資。
今年初，我們更新了 Multi-Year Goals，該目標最初於財務年度 2023 年提出，反映與我們平衡成長策略一致的目標。於財務年度 2026 年，我們預期這些目標將持續進展，包括：
•至財務年度 2027 年底，達到超過 200 個現行社區，
•至財務年度 2027 年底，將我們的淨負債與淨資本化比率降至低 30% 範圍，以及
•從財務年度 2024 年底至財務年度 2027 年，實現書面每股價值的雙位數複合年成長率。
Beazer 所建造的住宅旨在啟發永續與健康的生活方式。我們聚焦於四項戰略差異點，我們相信這些差異點能為購屋者帶來具體的財務與生活品質效益。我們的差異點如下：
Advanced Home Performance – 每一間 Beazer 房屋皆建構以提供可衡量且領先產業的優勢於效率、舒適度與耐久性。我們的建構標準支援更健康的、更安靜且更舒適的居住環境，同時降低持續運作成本，特別是在能源效率與公用事業費用方面。關鍵性能要素包括：

•能源節省：這是我們協助買家應對日益普遍的負擔能力問題的多種方式之一。我們已成為領先的能源效率住宅建造商，提供已證實的效率並降低客戶的每月公用費用。為量化並傳達我們建構的優勢，我們為買家提供個別能源評級（HERS® 指數分數），由合格的第三方評級公司完成。根據住宅能源服務網路（Residential Energy Services Network）的資料，現有住宅通常具有 HERS 指數分數（分數越低越好）為 130，而符合 HERS 參考住宅標準（相當於 2006 年國際能源節約規範）的住宅具有 HERS 指數分數為 100。相較之下，截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日財務年度，Beazer 新建住宅的平均 HERS 指數分數為 32，顯示我們建構所帶來的顯著優越表現。

作為我們對能源效率承諾的一部分，Beazer 新建住宅幾乎全部符合美國能源部（Department of Energy）的零能源準備標準，意味著適當尺寸的可再生能源來源（例如太陽能）可提供住宅所有能源需求，減少使用與費用。透過確保所有住宅皆具備太陽能安裝的基礎設施（太陽能準備），我們使客戶能在自己的時間軸上追求太陽能投資，同時仍能提供高度效率建構的顯著優勢。此外，我們已開始推出包含太陽能的社區，其中每一間住宅皆包含完整安裝的太陽能能源系統。
•更清潔的空氣：透過我們對美國環境保護署（U.S. Environmental Protection Agency，簡稱 EPA）室內空氣 Plus 計畫的承諾，我們為房東創造更健康的呼吸環境，透過特別設計的 HVAC 系統提供改善的室內空氣品質。
•更安靜的住宅：我們增強的建構作法包含增加的絕緣層，不僅可減少溫度波動並提高能源效率，同時也能降低噪音，創造更平靜且舒適的居住環境。
精選選擇 – Beazer 長久以來以提供選擇聞名，我們已擴展並重新定義選擇的意義，以更好地符合房東日益變化的需求。

paragraphs: 財務年度 2025 年呈現挑戰性的營運環境，主要受到持續的負擔能力擔憂、房貸利率偏高、消費者情緒低迷，以及總體經濟環境持續不確定性的影響。為應對此情況，我們提供折扣與激勵措施以刺激銷售並處理存貨。我們同時維持對營運與資本配置的嚴謹態度。這包括減緩土地支出以符合當前市場狀況、重新協商更有利的土地取得條款，並透過擴大使用土地選擇權契約來追求資本效率成長機會。在財務年度 2025 年，我們將更多資本分配至股票回購，因本公司股票交易價格低於帳面價值，我們認為這代表一個有吸引力的投資機會。儘管銷售環境較弱，我們仍認為長遠的住宅市場條件為有利，過去十年的生產缺口導致住宅供應長期不足。
在財務年度 2025 年，我們持續穩步朝向 Multi-Year Goals 目標前進，並保持在達成這些目標的軌道上。
•成長：於財務年度 2027 年底達成超過 200 個活躍社區，
•去槓桿：於財務年度 2027 年底將本公司淨負債與淨資本化比率降至低 30% 範圍，且
•每股帳面價值：從財務年度 2024 年底至財務年度 2027 年，每股帳面價值實現雙位數的年複合成長率。
截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，本公司活躍社區數為 169 個，較前一年的 162 個成長 4.3%。這標誌著我們連續第三年活躍社區數成長，我們正朝向於財務年度 2027 年底達成超過 200 個活躍社區的目標前進。

截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，本公司總負債與總資本化比率為 45.2%，淨負債與淨資本化比率為 39.5%，較前一年分別下降 20 基點與 50 基點，儘管營運環境困難。此減少反映本公司資本配置與戰略資產對齊決策，以調節土地支出並增加土地銷售。憑藉強固的資產負債表與充足的流動性，我們認為本公司已具備良好條件應對市場動態的變化，並於財務年度 2027 年底將淨負債與淨資本化比率降至低 30% 範圍。
截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，本公司每股帳面價值為 42.57 美元，較前一年的 40.05 美元成長 6.3%。此成長反映本公司持續的獲利能力與積極的股票回購計畫，該計畫已對長期價值創造產生重大貢獻。在財務年度 2025 年，本公司回購 1.5 百萬股本公司普通股，約為本公司發行在外股數的 5%，總金額為 33.1 百萬美元，平均每股價格為 22.20 美元。
展望財務年度2026，我們持續推動實現多年度目標，同時維持強勁的流動性地位。我們正在加速品牌建設與行銷努力，以傳達我們的差異化價值主張並推動客戶參與。此價值主張的關鍵零組件之一是我們住宅的能源效率，這使房東能夠產生顯著的電力節省並降低其總所有成本。我們認為這些運營與戰略措施將強化我們的差異化市場地位，並支持對股東產生重大價值的創造。
以下為我們在財務年度2025期間，針對某些關鍵運營與財務指標的表現總結，與財務年度2024相比。

•在截至2025年9月30日的財務年度中，我們的平均活躍社區數為164，較前一年的144成長14.2%。截至2025年9月30日，我們的期末活躍社區數為169，較前一年的162成長4.3%。我們在截至2025年9月30日的財務年度中，投資了684.0 百萬美元於土地取得與土地開發，較前一年的776.5 百萬美元下降11.9%。為回應市場條件的變化，我們將部分土地投資重新配置，以達成多年度目標的去槓桿化與成長每股帳面價值。此轉變顯示我們對強勁土地地位與對社區數成長可見度的信心。

headings: 通貨膨脹可能透過使成本增加而對本公司造成不利影響，而本公司可能無法透過提價來彌補這些成本增加。
若本公司無法成功與其他住宅建築商競爭，本公司市佔率可能下降或成長可能受阻，進而使本公司財務狀況與營運成果受損。
取消率增加將對本公司業務造成負面影響，並可能導致與未來將交付住宅（待交付訂單）相關之預估數字不準確。
本公司長期成功取決於本公司能否以合理價格取得符合住宅建築標準之完工地塊與未開發土地，並符合本公司土地投資標準。
住宅銷售數量減少將延長本公司回收土地購買新建物開發成本的時間，進而對利潤率與營運成果造成負面影響。
天然災害及其他相關事件可能導致土地開發或住宅建設延遲，增加本公司成本或降低受影響地區之需求。
供應短缺及其他與專業勞工及建材需求相關的風險，可能提高成本、延遲交貨，並可能對本公司財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司受廣泛政府規範管制，可能導致本公司產生重大負債或限制本公司營運活動。
與聯邦「Energy Star」或「Zero Energy」計畫相關的稅務優惠限制或取消，可能對本公司業務產生重大影響。
本公司與永續發展相關的業務活動及揭露資訊，可能使本公司面臨風險。
本公司可能因施工缺陷、產品責任及保固主張而面臨重大潛在負債。
在任何時間點，本公司可能成為民事訴訟的被告，可能導致本公司需支付重大賠償，或對本公司產生重大不利影響。
本公司依賴某些關鍵員工的服務，其服務喪失可能對本公司業務造成損害。
資訊科技系統故障、網路安全事件或資料安全事件可能對本公司業務造成損害。
全球經濟與政治不穩定及衝突可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
針對美國的恐怖攻擊或戰爭行為，或國內外不穩定情況增加，可能對我們的營運產生不利影響。
我們取得資金的能力及獲得額外融資的能力建議可能受到信用評級降級、資本市場限制或不利信用市場條件的影響。
我們使用淨營業虧損及稅收抵免的能力，過去已受到「所有權變更」（根據美國內政部稅收法第 382 與第 383 條款）的影響，未來也可能受到此影響。
若我們無法取得合理價格的融資，將可能無法取得及開發用於我們社區的土地，進而導致住宅銷售與收入減少。
資本配置效率不足或不當，可能對我們的營運成果及/或股東價值產生不利影響。

paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列風險因素，以及本 Form 10-K 中的其他資訊，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。發生下列任何事件，都可能影響本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能會下跌，您可能會損失全部或部分投資。
影響我們銷售住宅需求的許多條件，皆超出我們的控制範圍。許多這些條件，例如利率、通貨膨脹、就業水平、工資水平與政府措施，也會影響消費者信心，而我們的業務高度依賴此信心。
國家與地區層面的經濟條件惡化，以及我們營運所在地的當地經濟條件惡化，可能會使購屋者更加謹慎，進而導致較少的購屋行為。在會計年度 2025 年，由於購屋者持續面對高利率環境，即使聯邦儲備委員會在會計年度 2025 年多次降息，需求仍趨緩。這種持續的經濟不確定性超出我們的控制範圍，影響買家的觀感與行為，以及我們銷售住宅的需求，並對我們高度依賴的消費者信心產生負面影響。
這些條件的惡化以及/或住宅建築業進一步衰退，也可能導致其他影響，例如美國各住宅市場的新屋與二手屋存貨過度供給、違約率增加、消費者對新屋需求減少、取消率增加、住宅建築商間激烈價格競爭，以及促進住宅銷售的激勵措施增加，任何一種情況都可能導致本公司營收、獲利或毛利率下降，並對本公司財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響。
此外，任何特定政府措施，例如美國聯邦政府持續停擺或美國對某些進口商品，特別是原材料、商品及製造地點在美國以外的產品，這些產品用於我們的住宅建造過程，可能會干擾我們的住宅完工流程，或導致我們的住宅建造成本上升，這將對我們的業務與營運成果產生負面影響。
由於大多數客戶需要房貸 financing，利率持續高企與進一步利率上漲，將很可能對我們銷售住宅的負擔能力產生負面影響。此外，房貸可得性減少或擁有住宅的有效成本增加，可能會阻止客戶購買我們的住宅，並對我們的業務與財務結果產生負面影響。
